# SOHARTH — Celestial Luxury Streetwear

> Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) Indian luxury streetwear label engineering heavyweight 240+ GSM bio-washed combed cotton oversized t-shirts, drop-shoulder silhouettes, and celestial cultural graphic tees.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name**: SOHARTH
- **Website**: https://soharth.in
- **Location**: India (Domestic fulfillment across 19,000+ PIN codes)
- **Support WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/919137773967 (+91 91377 73967)
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/soharth.in/

## Product & Fabric Engineering
- **Fabric Weight**: 240+ GSM (Grams per Square Meter) heavy-duty premium cotton.
- **Yarn**: 100% Super-combed pure long-staple cotton fibers.
- **Treatment**: Double bio-washed for deep ultra-soft hand feel and zero pillage; pre-shrunk to retain structure wash after wash.
- **Silhouettes**: Relaxed drop-shoulder cut, boxy oversized torso drape, and high-density ribbed collar that does not sag.
- **Printing**: High-definition digital direct-to-garment (DTG) and high-density screenprints engineered to resist cracking.

## Collections
- **The Void Atelier / Heavyweight Essentials**: Minimalist solid black drop-shoulder tees engineered for structured daily architectural wear.
- **Cultural & Celestial Graphic Streetwear**: Graphic tees featuring celestial geometry, dark cyberpunk motifs, and Indian ethnic fusion iconography (The King, Moon Knight, Matrix, Baba Yaga).

## Key Policies & Customer Guarantees
- **Payment Options**: Cash on Delivery (COD) available across India + Zero-Fee UPI & Cards (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM).
- **Shipping**: Free Express Delivery across India on all prepaid orders and orders above ₹999. Dispatch within 24-48 business hours.
- **Returns & Exchanges**: 7-Day Hassle-Free doorstep pickup and size exchanges.
- **Size Range**: S, M, L, XL, XXL (Dual measurement system in Inches and Centimeters with live recommendation chart).
